text: dsh-easy2restart 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的重启与会话归档插件。它在侧栏加入重启按钮、归档确认界面和已归档会话浏览页；用户可双击按钮重启 DSH，归档成功后由主机端安排本地备份，并可在右侧栏查看归档会话文件。备份设置支持关闭或指定目录。适合需要管理 DSH 桌面会话与快速重启的用户；Windows 计划任务和 PowerShell 是重启所需条件。

dsh-easy2restart adds restart and archive tools to DSH Web: a sidebar restart button, archive confirmation, and an archived-session browser. Successful archives trigger local backups. Backups can be disabled or assigned a directory; restarting needs Windows Task Scheduler and PowerShell.

dsh-easy2restart README · ⚠️ 已知 DSH 启动问题（与本插件无关）：每次启动 DSH 都会向桌面 cookie 库新增一条 `dsh-auth-*` cookie（127.0.0.1、每次启动端口随机，所以 cookie 名不同、不会覆盖旧条目）。它的有效期是 **30 天**，30 天内不会自己消失；累积到 **71 条**时 Cookie 请求头超过 16 KB 上限，host 返回 **431**，桌面握手失败 —— 就是上面这个弹窗。所以**重启越频繁，越快撞线**：一天重启几次的话，大约一个月内必然出现。

**为什么点「Disable…」没用｜Why the "Disable" button doesn't help**

这个按钮只是**禁用**所有第三方插件（注意是禁用，不是删除、不是清空 —— 插件本体和配置都还在），然后重启一次。问题出在 cookie 累积，跟插件没有关系，所以点完照样起不来，反而暂时失去全部第三方插件能力，还得手动重新启用。`Restart` 按钮同理，只会再撞一次。

**处理办法｜Fix**

dsh-easy2restart README · 1. Restart DSH：- Injects a restart button into the `sidebar.footer.action` slot (above the account avatar / settings), drawn as an inline SVG open ring with an arrow.
- **Double-click** → the host launches a PowerShell script **detached from the DSH process tree** via Windows Task Scheduler; the script uses `taskkill /T` to force-kill the whole DSH process tree, then relaunches `DeepSeek Harness.exe`.

**为什么点「Disable…」没用｜Why the "Disable" button doesn't help**

dsh-easy2restart README · 1. Restart DSH：- Injects a restart button into the `sidebar.footer.action` slot (above the account avatar / settings), drawn as an inline SVG open ring with an arrow.
- **Double-click** → the host launches a PowerShell script **detached from the DSH process tree** via Windows Task Scheduler; the script uses `taskkill /T` to force-kill the whole DSH process tree, then relaunches `DeepSeek Harness.exe`.

dsh-easy2restart README · 2. Safe archiving (confirm + activity guard)：1. **Every archive entry (menu / row button / shortcut) opens a confirm dialog first.** When auto-backup is on, it also names the target folder; when off, it warns in red that no backup copy will be made.
2. **Second confirmation while the session is still busy**: if the host rejects with `workspace/session-active`, the dialog switches to "**session is active**" plus an activity list (running turn / subagents / background jobs / schedules); "stop and archive" unlocks only after a **10-second countdown**.

dsh-easy2restart README · 3. Archive means backup (event-driven, no polling)：- The host wraps `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession`: 3 seconds after a successful archive it copies the session file, attachments, title cache and metadata to `<backup root>\<title>-<archive-time>\`.

- Archive a session as usual — the confirm dialog comes first; if the session is still busy, wait for the countdown, then "stop and archive".
- About 3 seconds after archiving, the backup runs; watch `~/.dsh/archive-backup/auto-backup.log`.
- Moving to another disk: right sidebar → "Archived sessions" → "Auto-backup" → change the folder → save; the next archive uses it.

dsh-easy2restart README · How it works (brief)：- `lib/index.js` (host / Cordis plugin): restart routing via `schtasks` + `restart/restart.ps1`; wraps `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession` and schedules a backup 3 seconds after a successful archive (plus a catch-up scan 5 seconds after startup); `backupSetting()` / `probeBackupDir()` / `pickBackupDirectory()` back the settings UI; serves read-only archive browsing under `<DSH_HOME>/sessions` with a path guard.
- `restart/restart.ps1`: `taskkill /PID <main process> /T /F`, wait for exit, then `Start-Process DeepSeek Harness.exe`.
- `lib/client.js` (Web client): registers `sidebar.footer.action` (restart button), `shell.overlay` (archive confirm dialog) and `sidebar.right.pane.tab` (archived sessions page), and wraps `uiWorkspace.archiveSession`.

- Only archive entries that go through `uiWorkspace.archiveSession` are intercepted. If DSH routes archiving elsewhere in the future, there is no confirm dialog and no automatic backup for that path.
- Re-archiving triggers the dialog and a backup again (deduplicated by SHA256, so no wasted space).
- The right-sidebar page reads only the DSH session directory; the backup copy is not browsable there.
- Changing the backup folder does not migrate existing backups.

dsh-easy2restart README · Data & privacy：- Backups stay on the local disk (default `F:\AI\会话归档备份\DSH\`); nothing is uploaded.
- Diagnostics: `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-easy2restart/host-boot.log`, `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-easy2restart/diag.log`, `~/.dsh/archive-backup/auto-backup.log`.
